description: NotebookLM for a dreamteamer workspace — the export, the harness, and notebooks records that rebuild a live notebook on any account.

dreamteamer.title: NotebookLM
dreamteamer.description: Everything NotebookLM, in one module. The engine extension: `dt notebooklm` writes the schema, the records and a persona as a bounded set of sources (and, given a notebook, syncs them), and the `notebooklm` harness keeps NOTEBOOKLM.md's configuration block current on every compile — collections marked `sensitive: true` and fields marked `x-sensitive: true` never travel. The record: a `notebooks` record is the SPEC a live NotebookLM notebook can be rebuilt from on any Google account — its ordered `sources`, the one `configure` call in `chat`, the uuid and login of the live copy — and `npx dt-notebook restore` plays it, `capture` writes it from a live notebook, `persona` applies NOTEBOOKLM.md's persona in one safe call (a bare `configure` CLEARS it, measured twice). The rules: `using-notebooklm` defers to the vendor's own skill for every flag and adds only this workspace's. Peers `wikis` — a notebook points at the local corpora it is built on, and `wiki pull` is the one bridge between them — and `companies`, so a client corpus can say whose it is.
